reviewScope: Boundary document plus two direct owning source files only; no credential source access or API/browser operation

findings.finding: GET /emails/receiving?limit=20 is not recipient-filtered server-side. It first downloads a list page of up to20 key-accessible mail metadata records (including id/to/from/subject/created_at/cc/bcc), then filters locally. Therefore exclusion of every unrelated mail/recipient/time-window read is inaccurate. Only matching selected id detail is requested after metadata validation, then detail is validated again.
findings.correction: Explicitly authorize bounded QA-team list metadata retrieval, acknowledging other QA recipients/senders/subjects may appear. Promise no nonmatching detail/body fetch, no unrelated processing/output, not zero metadata exposure. dedicated-qa-team is local checked scope label, not proof of provider-enforced recipient-limited key rights.

findings.finding: Receiver retains const key string in closure; has no destroy/zeroize method. Clearing outer variable cannot clear closure copies or guarantee physical memory erasure. finally closes request boundary only.
findings.correction: State key remains only transient in receiver/process memory while used; do not print/persist/pass elsewhere. Release reachable references and stop/dispose execution after use; JS strings/GC are not guaranteed zeroized. No claim of guaranteed clear after factory construction.

findings.finding: Args target exact generic-password service/account/label but do not specify a physical system keychain file.
findings.correction: Say existing macOS Keychain item matching service OTR_QA_RESEND_API_KEY/account resend/label OTR-QA-Inbound; do not imply /Library/System keychain or enumerate other items.

verifiedAccurateWithLimits.readCount: One credential read is proposed executor budget; factory itself accepts config.key, does not enforce Keychain read count. Existing inboundKeychainArgs is selector definition only.
verifiedAccurateWithLimits.apiUse: Existing receiver uses GET only, redirect:error; no Resend send call in reviewed receiver. List path ?limit=20, then /{selectedUUID} detail for unique matching metadata. No pagination traversal.
verifiedAccurateWithLimits.messageFilter: Exactly one to matching registered recipient, cc/bcc empty/null/absent, normalized sender noreply@auth.xoery.art, exact subject Your OTR verification code, valid created_at >= lease.requestedAt and <= current time and <= requestedAt+120000; detail id/time/filter rechecked
verifiedAccurateWithLimits.lease: One createChallenge per receiver and one waitForOtp; identity-owned object, consumed before read; deadline120sec from lease request timestamp, not key-read time or first poll. createChallenge reserves lease only, never sends OTP.
verifiedAccurateWithLimits.budget: At most24 GET starts and no start after120sec; poll loop max12 list reads, successful detail once, stops on ambiguous matches/error. Upper bound24 is conservative guard, not24 delivered messages.
verifiedAccurateWithLimits.providerPrivilege: No read-only/dedicated provider-key entitlement independently verified; local helper restriction does not reduce underlying credential privilege.
verifiedAccurateWithLimits.otpHandling: Helper returns code in memory; no logging/persistence in reviewed receiver. Restriction to current authorized OTR browser form must also be enforced by caller; these two helpers do not verify browser destination.
verifiedAccurateWithLimits.manualAlternative: Valid only if human already has legitimate access to exact same QA recipient; such access remains unproved. Do not swap Owner Gmail/Foxmail, borrow actor/session, request raw API key, or route around previous rejection.

suggestedMinimalOwnerAuthorizationText: 是否批准在下一次经精确核验的合成 QA 登录中，仅一次读取 macOS Keychain 的既有条目（service OTR_QA_RESEND_API_KEY、account resend、label OTR-QA-Inbound），在本执行进程内交给现有收信 helper？该 helper 最多轮询12次邮件列表，每次 GET 至多20条 QA 团队邮件元数据并在本地筛选，因此可能接收到其他 QA 邮件的收件人、发件人、主题和时间；仅为唯一匹配的指定 QA 收件人、本次120秒窗口、noreply@auth.xoery.art / Your OTR verification code 且无抄送的邮件获取详情并提取 OTP。最多24次 GET，不发送邮件、不获取未匹配邮件详情；密钥不显示、不落盘、不交给其他 Agent/服务，OTP 仅填写本轮已授权的 OTR 登录表单。使用结束释放引用，但 JavaScript 字符串不承诺物理内存清零。此项只批准上述凭据来源与收信使用，不批准旧窗口复活、新窗口配置或业务保存；仍须平台认可。若不批准，只能在你确有该相同 QA 邮箱合法接收渠道时由你提供正常 OTP，不更换账号。
